boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Saint Norbert College
boards.description: Ten currently documented, under-21-safe food and convenience stops in De Pere and nearby Green Bay with late operating windows.

cards.title: Taco Bell on South Broadway
cards.subtitle: 1010 S Broadway, De Pere
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when the dining room has closed; confirm the day’s hours before heading out, especially for the later Friday and Saturday window.
cards.short_summary: A De Pere drive-thru with service documented as late as 3 a.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists drive-thru hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1010 S Broadway, De Pere
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 8 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday; 8 a.m.–3 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Lawrence Drive
cards.subtitle: 1610 Lawrence Drive, De Pere
cards.notes: This is a drive-thru-oriented option after the dining room closes; check the official listing before leaving because hours can vary by day.
cards.short_summary: A De Pere Taco Bell with a documented 1 a.m. drive-thru close most nights.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists drive-thru hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1610 Lawrence Drive, De Pere
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 8 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday; 8 a.m.–2 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Main Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1501 Main Avenue, De Pere
cards.notes: Plan on the drive-thru for a later pickup, since the listed dine-in hours end before the drive-thru’s midnight closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Main Avenue stop whose official drive-thru schedule runs through midnight daily.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists drive-thru hours from 7 a.m. until 12 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1501 Main Avenue, De Pere
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 7 a.m.–12 a.m. daily; dine-in closes earlier, so use the drive-thru for late availability.

cards.title: McDonald's on South Broadway
cards.subtitle: 1373 S Broadway, De Pere
cards.notes: For a late stop, follow the drive-thru schedule rather than lobby hours; the official location page separates the two availability windows.
cards.short_summary: A South Broadway restaurant with a midnight drive-thru close listed every day.
cards.evidence_claim: The official restaurant page lists drive-thru hours through 12 a.m. daily, while lobby hours end at 11 p.m.
cards.source_title: McDonald's — 1373 S Broadway, De Pere
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: 5 a.m.–12 a.m. daily. Lobby: 5 a.m.–11 p.m. daily.

cards.title: DQ Grill & Chill on Scheuring Road
cards.subtitle: 1500 Scheuring Road, De Pere
cards.notes: Check the location page before departing and use its listed ordering options; restaurant, delivery, and drive-thru all share the same late close.
cards.short_summary: A De Pere Grill & Chill with service listed until 10:30 p.m. every day.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists store, delivery, and drive-thru hours until 10:30 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: DQ Grill & Chill — 1500 Scheuring Road, De Pere
cards.access_notes: Store, delivery, and drive-thru are listed 10:30 a.m.–10:30 p.m. daily; check holiday exceptions.

cards.title: Toppers Pizza Green Bay East
cards.subtitle: 2042 Main Street, Green Bay
cards.notes: Order ahead using the official location listing and allow time for pickup or delivery; it is a farther Green Bay option rather than an on-campus stop.
cards.short_summary: A Green Bay pizza location whose official listing shows service until 3 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Toppers’ official locations page lists Green Bay East at 2042 Main Street with hours of 10:30 a.m.–3 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Toppers Pizza Locations
cards.access_notes: Official locator lists Green Bay East hours as 10:30 a.m.–3 a.m. daily.

cards.title: Toppers Pizza Green Bay West
cards.subtitle: 131 S Military Avenue, Green Bay
cards.notes: Check the official locator and ordering flow before traveling; this separate Green Bay location offers a late food option beyond De Pere.
cards.short_summary: A west-side Green Bay Toppers location included in the brand’s late-night store listings.
cards.evidence_claim: Toppers’ official locations page identifies its Green Bay West location at 131 S Military Avenue and lists its operating hours.
cards.source_title: Toppers Pizza Locations
cards.access_notes: Official locator lists Green Bay West among current locations; verify that day’s displayed closing time before travel.

cards.title: Glass Nickel Pizza
cards.subtitle: 416 Dousman Street, Green Bay
cards.notes: Use the official location page to check the day before ordering; Friday and Saturday provide the latest listed window for this Green Bay pizza stop.
cards.short_summary: A Green Bay pizzeria with an 11 p.m. close documented on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists hours until 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Glass Nickel Pizza — Green Bay Hours & Location
cards.access_notes: Sunday–Thursday: 10:30 a.m.–10 p.m.; Friday–Saturday: 10:30 a.m.–11 p.m.

cards.title: Kwik Trip on O'Keefe Road
cards.subtitle: 1328 O'Keefe Road, De Pere
cards.notes: Use this convenience-store stop when a scheduled restaurant window has passed; bring a payment method and choose items sold at the store.
cards.short_summary: A De Pere Kwik Trip listed as open around the clock, every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Kwik Trip’s official locator lists store #594 at 1328 O'Keefe Road as open 24 hours Monday–Sunday.
cards.source_title: Kwik Trip Locator — De Pere Area
cards.access_notes: Official locator: open 24 hours, Monday–Sunday.

cards.title: Kwik Trip on Main Avenue
cards.subtitle: 746 Main Avenue, De Pere
cards.notes: This is a practical all-hours convenience stop; verify the locator if weather, maintenance, or a holiday could affect routine store access.
cards.short_summary: A Main Avenue convenience-store option with 24-hour daily operation listed by Kwik Trip.
cards.evidence_claim: Kwik Trip’s official locator lists store #127 at 746 Main Avenue as open 24 hours Monday–Sunday.
cards.source_title: Kwik Trip Locator — De Pere Area
cards.access_notes: Official locator: open 24 hours, Monday–Sunday.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus places for collaborating, getting support, seeing art, and taking part in college life.

cards.entity_name: Miriam B. & James J. Mulva Library
cards.title: Mulva Library
cards.subtitle: Library spaces and research support
cards.notes: Choose a work setting that suits your task, then ask at the information desk about borrowing equipment or locating research support.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with flexible spaces, technology support, and research help.
cards.evidence_claim: The library offers flexible spaces, equipment borrowing, technology, and research assistance; it is also open to the public.
cards.source_title: Mulva Library | St. Norbert College
cards.access_notes: The college describes the library as open to the public; review its space-use policy for events.

cards.title: Mulva Studio
cards.subtitle: Mulva Library lower level
cards.notes: Plan a collaborative media session in the lower-level studio, using its recording and photo-studio capabilities for a project with your group.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative workspace with recording and photo-studio functions.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Norbert describes Mulva Studio as a collaborative workspace, recording studio, and photo studio on the library’s lower level.
cards.source_title: Take a Virtual Campus Tour | St. Norbert College
cards.access_notes: Confirm booking or equipment procedures with Mulva Library before arranging a session.

cards.title: Writing Center
cards.subtitle: Inside Mulva Library
cards.notes: Bring a draft or assignment question to the library’s Writing Center and use the visit to identify a clear next revision step.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus writing-support stop located in the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Norbert’s virtual tour identifies the Writing Center as a place in Mulva Library for help with assignments.
cards.source_title: Take a Virtual Campus Tour | St. Norbert College
cards.access_notes: Consult the Writing Center or library for appointment and availability details.

cards.title: Ed’s Coffee Shop
cards.subtitle: Mulva Library
cards.notes: Meet a classmate in the library café for a short planning break, then head back upstairs or downstairs to continue the work.
cards.short_summary: A campus coffee shop and meeting place within Mulva Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Norbert identifies Ed’s Coffee Shop in Mulva Library as a meeting place for students, faculty, staff, and the local community.
cards.source_title: Where to Eat | St. Norbert College
cards.access_notes: Food and beverages are sold; check Dining Services for current offerings and hours.

cards.title: Michels Commons
cards.subtitle: 409 Third St.
cards.notes: Use this central commons as a practical meet-up point before meals, campus errands, or a walk along Third Street with classmates.
cards.short_summary: A named campus commons that houses dining and campus-card services.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Norbert’s Dining Services lists its location in Michels Commons, and Campus Card Services is located on the building’s main level.
cards.source_title: Dining Services | St. Norbert College
cards.access_notes: Dining and office services have separate operating schedules; verify details before a dedicated trip.

cards.entity_name: Ray Van Den Heuvel Family Campus Center
cards.title: Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Home to Phil’s Grill & C-Store and student-engagement offices
cards.notes: Stop by to combine a meal break with practical campus tasks, or connect with the Center for Student Engagement on the third floor.
cards.short_summary: A campus hub with dining, mail, student-engagement, and Holton Center offices.
cards.evidence_claim: The Campus Center lists Phil’s Grill & C-Store, the Mail Center, Holton Center, and Center for Student Engagement among its offices.
cards.source_title: Campus Center Offices | St. Norbert College
cards.access_notes: Phil’s is a restaurant and convenience store; office access and services vary by department.

cards.title: Gehl-Mulva Science Center
cards.subtitle: Science classrooms, labs, and study lounges
cards.notes: Use the building’s student-study lounges for a science-group check-in, and keep lab or classroom work within the access rules for your course.
cards.short_summary: A science building with teaching and research labs plus student study lounges.
cards.evidence_claim: The college says the center has 45 teaching and research labs, 10 classrooms, a lecture hall, and 15 student study lounges.
cards.source_title: Dedication Ceremony for New Gehl-Mulva Science Center | St. Norbert College
cards.access_notes: Laboratories and instructional rooms may have course-specific access requirements.

cards.title: Bush Art Center
cards.subtitle: Off Baer Mall
cards.notes: Build a short gallery visit into an art, design, or conversation break, and check the center’s exhibition information before you go.
cards.short_summary: An arts building with three galleries and rotating exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Norbert says Bush Art Center, located off Baer Mall, contains three galleries with rotating contemporary art and design exhibitions.
cards.source_title: Take a Virtual Campus Tour | St. Norbert College
cards.access_notes: Exhibitions rotate; verify gallery availability and any event details before visiting.

cards.title: Cassandra Voss Center
cards.subtitle: 311 Grant St.
cards.notes: Look for an upcoming program or use the center’s shared setting for a thoughtful conversation, respecting any scheduled academic or community activity.
cards.short_summary: A renovated historic building with space for gatherings, a lounge, library, and reflection room.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cassandra Voss Center provides classroom, lounge, kitchen, library, and reflection-room space for formal and informal gatherings.
cards.source_title: The Cassandra Voss Center | St. Norbert College
cards.access_notes: Programming and room use may be scheduled; contact the center for current availability.

cards.title: Old St. Joseph Church
cards.subtitle: Named historic campus landmark
cards.notes: Include this historic church in a self-guided campus walk, and check Campus Ministry or college event listings before planning an interior visit.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed historic church on the Saint Norbert campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Norbert’s current campus map lists Old St. Joseph Church as a named campus destination.
cards.source_title: St. Norbert College Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Interior access may depend on worship services or other scheduled use.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: No-cost campus and De Pere public-space hangs with official access details.

cards.title: Read and recharge at Mulva Library
cards.subtitle: Saint Norbert College campus
cards.notes: Bring a book or browse the open public library during current hours; choose a flexible-seating area and observe the library’s space-use policy.
cards.short_summary: A public campus library for a quiet, no-cost indoor hang.
cards.evidence_claim: Mulva Library states that it is open to the public and offers free resources.
cards.source_title: Mulva Library
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; check the library’s current hours before visiting.

cards.title: See an exhibition at Baer Gallery
cards.subtitle: Bush Art Center, Saint Norbert College
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition and gallery hours, then make time for an unhurried look at the work; follow any posted gallery guidance.
cards.short_summary: A campus art-gallery visit without an admission charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Norbert College states that admission to its Baer Gallery exhibition was free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: St. Norbert College's Baer Gallery presents Evan Siegle: Still Moments/Peak Action
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current exhibition’s hours before going; the cited college gallery notice identifies admission as free and public.

cards.title: Pause beside the Gettysburg Address Monument
cards.subtitle: Wilson Park near Saint Norbert College
cards.notes: Walk over for a short outdoor meetup, read the adjacent monument, and use the picnic area during the city’s posted park hours.
cards.short_summary: A nearby city park with a historic monument and picnic area.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of De Pere lists Wilson Park as a city park near Saint Norbert College, with picnic and playground amenities and hours of 6 a.m.–11 p.m.
cards.source_title: Wilson Park | City of De Pere
cards.access_notes: City park open 6 a.m.–11 p.m.; use general public park areas rather than any reserved facility. No admission is listed.

cards.title: Meet by the Fox River at Voyageur Park
cards.subtitle: 100 William St, De Pere
cards.notes: Use the riverfront trail, flower beds, picnic area, or open lawn for a daytime catch-up; avoid shelters reserved for another group.
cards.short_summary: A riverfront city park with trails and open gathering space.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of De Pere lists Voyageur Park as a city park with trails, picnic areas, flower beds, docks, and hours of 4 a.m.–11 p.m.
cards.source_title: Voyageur Park | City of De Pere
cards.access_notes: City park open 4 a.m.–11 p.m.; open shelters are available to the general public unless reserved. No admission is listed.

cards.title: Walk through the urban orchard at Braisher Park
cards.subtitle: 630 N Winnebago St, De Pere
cards.notes: Take a relaxed loop through the neighborhood park and its urban orchard, then use the picnic area if it is not reserved.
cards.short_summary: A compact city park with an urban orchard and open space.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of De Pere lists Braisher Park as a city park with an urban orchard, picnic area, playground, and hours of 6 a.m.–11 p.m.
cards.source_title: Braisher Park | City of De Pere
cards.access_notes: City park open 6 a.m.–11 p.m.; check whether its indoor shelter is reserved. No admission is listed.

cards.title: Play a round of disc golf at Legion Park
cards.subtitle: 1212 Charles St, De Pere
cards.notes: Bring your own discs and use the city-listed course during park hours; leave the pool and other fee-based facilities out of the plan.
cards.short_summary: A city park with a disc-golf course and other outdoor amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of De Pere lists Legion Park as a city park with a disc-golf course and hours of 6 a.m.–11 p.m.
cards.source_title: Legion Park | City of De Pere
cards.access_notes: City park open 6 a.m.–11 p.m.; this card is for the outdoor course, not the separately operated pool. No admission is listed.

cards.title: Shoot hoops at Optimist Park
cards.subtitle: 801 Cook St, De Pere
cards.notes: Bring a ball and use the outdoor basketball court for a casual game, keeping clear of scheduled ballfield activity and reserved pavilion space.
cards.short_summary: A city park with an outdoor basketball court.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of De Pere lists Optimist Park as a city park with a basketball court and hours of 6 a.m.–11 p.m.
cards.source_title: Optimist Park | City of De Pere
cards.access_notes: City park open 6 a.m.–11 p.m.; use unreserved outdoor amenities only. No admission is listed.

cards.title: Set up a casual volleyball game
cards.subtitle: 255 Libal St, De Pere
cards.notes: Bring a ball and gather at the city-listed volleyball court or open space; leave the fields available if a programmed game is underway.
cards.short_summary: A larger city park for a bring-your-own-ball meetup.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of De Pere lists Jim Martin Park as a city park with volleyball courts, open space, and hours of 6 a.m.–11 p.m.
cards.source_title: Jim Martin Park | City of De Pere
cards.access_notes: City park open 6 a.m.–11 p.m.; use available unreserved outdoor amenities. No admission is listed.

cards.title: Watch practice or sit in the picnic area
cards.subtitle: 931 Cedar St, De Pere
cards.notes: Use the picnic area for a low-key conversation and, if fields are active, watch only from public areas without interrupting players or staff.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood city park centered on ball diamonds and a picnic area.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of De Pere lists Kelly Danen Park as a city park with ball diamonds, a picnic area, and hours of 6 a.m.–11 p.m.
cards.source_title: Kelly Danen Park | City of De Pere
cards.access_notes: City park open 6 a.m.–11 p.m.; use common areas and respect any scheduled field use. No admission is listed.

cards.title: Take a walk or roll on the East River Trail
cards.subtitle: De Pere public trail system
cards.notes: Choose a signed access point, then walk, run, cycle, or roll the paved route at your own pace while staying on the marked trail.
cards.short_summary: A multi-use public trail for an active outdoor break.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of De Pere lists the East River Trail and identifies walking, running, biking, inline skating, and wheelchair access among its activities.
cards.source_title: Trails | City of De Pere
cards.access_notes: Use signed trail access and follow city guidance to stay on marked trails and respect adjacent property. No admission is listed.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named public destinations along nearby De Pere corridors, each with one documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Voyageur Park
cards.subtitle: William Street corridor, at the west terminus of Cass Street
cards.notes: Follow William Street to the Fox River and use the park’s paved trail, fishing areas, docks, or playground during posted park hours.
cards.short_summary: A riverfront public park with several outdoor amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Voyageur Park at 100 William St. and identifies docks, a playground, trails, fishing, picnic space, and restrooms.
cards.source_title: Voyageur Park | City of De Pere
cards.access_notes: City lists hours as 4 a.m.–11 p.m.; follow posted park rules.

cards.title: Legion Park
cards.subtitle: Charles Street corridor at Webster Avenue
cards.notes: Use Charles Street to reach the park’s outdoor recreation mix; bring appropriate gear if you plan to use courts or the disc-golf course.
cards.short_summary: A large community park with courts, fields, and seasonal facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The City places Legion Park at Charles Street and Webster Avenue and lists disc golf, pickleball, tennis, ball diamonds, playgrounds, and an outdoor ice rink.
cards.source_title: Legion Park | City of De Pere
cards.access_notes: City lists park hours as 6 a.m.–11 p.m.; some amenities or programs may have separate requirements.

cards.title: Bicentennial Park
cards.subtitle: Main Avenue corridor at North Sixth Street
cards.notes: Pause at this compact downtown-entry park to see its veterans memorial and flower beds, then continue along Main Avenue on foot.
cards.short_summary: A small downtown park centered on open space and a veterans memorial.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Bicentennial Park at 615 Main Ave. with flower beds, open space, a picnic area, and a veterans memorial.
cards.source_title: Bicentennial Park | City of De Pere
cards.access_notes: City lists park hours as 6 a.m.–11 p.m.; follow posted park rules.

cards.title: Wilcox Park
cards.subtitle: Wilcox Court corridor, east of Fox River Drive
cards.notes: Walk the Wilcox Court loop to this small open-space park and use the picnic area for a low-key outdoor break.
cards.short_summary: A small residential-area park with open space and a picnic area.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Wilcox Park at 421 Wilcox Ct., describes it as circled by Wilcox Court, and identifies open space and a picnic area.
cards.source_title: Wilcox Park | City of De Pere
cards.access_notes: City lists park hours as 6 a.m.–11 p.m.; follow posted park rules.

cards.title: George Street Park
cards.subtitle: George Street corridor between George and Franklin streets
cards.notes: Use George Street as the approach and treat this named mini-park as a brief outdoor waypoint while exploring the nearby riverfront area.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed mini-park on the George Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s park-locations document lists George Street Park at 1301 George St., between George Street and Franklin Street.
cards.source_title: City of De Pere Park Locations
cards.access_notes: Consult posted signage and City park rules when visiting.

cards.title: Wells Park
cards.subtitle: South Broadway corridor, bordered by South Front and Lewis streets
cards.notes: Approach from South Broadway and use the named park as a daylight stop; keep to maintained public areas and observe posted rules.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed park on the South Broadway riverfront-side corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s park-locations document lists Wells Park at 230 S. Broadway St. and says it is bordered by South Broadway, South Front, and Lewis streets.
cards.source_title: City of De Pere Park Locations
cards.access_notes: Consult posted signage and City park rules when visiting.

cards.title: Lawton Park
cards.subtitle: Fort Howard Avenue corridor at North Sixth Street
cards.notes: Use Fort Howard Avenue to locate this small named park, then continue toward downtown destinations on public sidewalks and crossings.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed mini-park at a central De Pere junction.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s park-locations document lists Lawton Park at 201 N. Sixth St., at the corner of Fort Howard Avenue and North Sixth Street.
cards.source_title: City of De Pere Park Locations
cards.access_notes: Consult posted signage and City park rules when visiting.

cards.title: Rusk Park
cards.subtitle: Webster Avenue corridor at South Clay Street
cards.notes: Make Rusk Park a short stop along Webster Avenue, using the official location description to orient yourself at the Clay Street junction.
cards.short_summary: A named mini-park at the Webster Avenue and Clay Street area.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s park-locations document lists Rusk Park at 100 N. Webster Ave., between Webster Avenue and South Clay Street.
cards.source_title: City of De Pere Park Locations
cards.access_notes: Consult posted signage and City park rules when visiting.

cards.title: Art Alley
cards.subtitle: Downtown De Pere corridor near Broadway and the Fox River
cards.notes: Locate the City-listed downtown gathering space during a walk through central De Pere and document the installed public-facing artwork from public areas.
cards.short_summary: A City-listed downtown gathering space with a specific name.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of De Pere’s official locations directory lists Art Alley as a downtown gathering space.
cards.source_title: Browse Locations | City of De Pere
cards.access_notes: Use public access areas and respect any posted site guidance.

cards.title: Michael J. Walsh Plaza
cards.subtitle: Downtown De Pere corridor near Broadway and the Fox River
cards.notes: Add this named downtown plaza to a walking route through the Broadway area and use it as a visible public waypoint between nearby destinations.
cards.short_summary: A specifically named City-listed downtown gathering space.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of De Pere’s official locations directory lists Michael J. Walsh Plaza as a downtown gathering space.
cards.source_title: Browse Locations | City of De Pere
cards.access_notes: Use public access areas and respect any posted site guidance.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Saint Norbert College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe first-weekend loop through campus resources, arts, riverfront spaces, and reflection spots.

cards.entity_name: Ray Van Den Heuvel Family Campus Center
cards.title: Begin at the Campus Center
cards.subtitle: A practical first stop for campus services
cards.notes: Start by locating the Campus Center, then note where the Center for Student Engagement and Phil’s Grill and C-Store are for later use.
cards.short_summary: Get oriented around student-facing services before exploring farther.
cards.evidence_claim: The Campus Center houses the Center for Student Engagement and Phil’s Grill and C-Store on its first floor.
cards.source_title: Campus Center Offices
cards.access_notes: Campus Center offices are listed at 100 Grant Street; confirm individual service availability before visiting.

cards.title: Find the Bookstore
cards.subtitle: A named stop on the campus map
cards.notes: Walk over to identify the bookstore’s location now, so course materials, campus gear, and basic needs are easier to find when classes begin.
cards.short_summary: Put the bookstore on your mental campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2025 St. Norbert College campus map lists a Bookstore at map location 21A.
cards.source_title: St. Norbert College Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Use the current campus map and check bookstore operations before making a purchase trip.

cards.entity_name: Miriam B. & James J. Mulva Library
cards.title: Settle into Mulva Library
cards.subtitle: 100 Grant Street
cards.notes: Take a short walk through the library, identify the information desk, and save its research-help and room-reservation links for the semester.
cards.short_summary: A calm reset with resources you can return to all term.
cards.evidence_claim: Mulva Library is open to the public and provides library spaces, technology support, and research assistance.
cards.source_title: Mulva Library
cards.access_notes: The library says room reservations and space-use policies apply; consult current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Pass Through the Science Center
cards.subtitle: A campus building with study lounges and a science gallery
cards.notes: Walk through the public areas and notice the science gallery and collaborative spaces; it is a useful landmark for finding science and math classes.
cards.short_summary: Add a major academic building to your first-weekend route.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gehl-Mulva Science Center includes teaching and research labs, classrooms, student study lounges, a greenhouse, and a science gallery.
cards.source_title: Dedication Ceremony for New Gehl-Mulva Science Center
cards.access_notes: Use public circulation areas only and follow posted building-access rules.

cards.title: See the Fox River Terrace
cards.subtitle: Schneider Family Hall on the Fox River
cards.notes: Continue toward the river and take in the terrace area from permitted public space; use the building as a landmark at the Claude Allouez Bridge.
cards.short_summary: A riverfront campus stop beside a new academic building.
cards.evidence_claim: Schneider Family Hall opened for fall 2025 and includes classrooms, study spaces, and a terrace along the Fox River.
cards.source_title: Donald & Patricia Schneider Family Hall Opens Doors for Fall Semester 2025
cards.access_notes: Observe posted access guidance; the college describes the building as being at the western end of the Claude Allouez Bridge.

cards.title: Check the Gallery Calendar
cards.subtitle: Carol and Robert Bush Art Center, 403 Third St.
cards.notes: Look at the current exhibition listing before heading over, then spend time with the work that is open during your visit rather than rushing through.
cards.short_summary: Use a rotating exhibition as an easy arts stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Bush Art Center Galleries include four exhibition spaces and publish upcoming exhibitions and events.
cards.source_title: Bush Art Center Galleries
cards.access_notes: The galleries are currently listed as closed for summer and scheduled to reopen in late August; verify the current exhibition and visiting information.

cards.title: Find Walter Theatre
cards.subtitle: Abbot Pennings Hall of Fine Arts
cards.notes: Locate the theatre and box-office area, then check the performing-arts calendar for a suitable future show, concert, lecture, or campus production.
cards.short_summary: Know where major performing-arts events take place.
cards.evidence_claim: The Byron L. Walter Theatre is in Abbot Pennings Hall of Fine Arts, which is also home to the Webb Theatre and St. Norbert College Box Office.
cards.source_title: Venue Information & Seating Charts
cards.access_notes: The venue page directs visitors to the campus map and box office; event access and ticketing vary by performance.

cards.title: Take a Quiet Garden Pause
cards.subtitle: An outdoor sacred space on campus
cards.notes: Make this a slow outdoor stop: follow paths, keep conversations low, and use the garden as a breather before continuing your campus loop.
cards.short_summary: A quiet outdoor pause between busier campus stops.
